name: Ilsa Owen-Gwynn
original_name: イルザ・オーウェン・グウィン
source:
"Round and round, let the wheel turn-- O transient, fragile little birds. Let me hear your fairy-tale."

- Origin: Delta Empire
- Birthday: March 8
- Height: 171cm
- Three Size: B91(F)/W62/H92
- Likes: Fairy tales/Cocoa
- Dislikes: Foreigners
- Will/Gem: "Clickety-clackety Illusory Train" Märchen Chrysopagion

A head officer of Delta Border Patrol, commonly known as DEVA.
She is known as "The Teller", one of the strongest in combat power.
During the happening of an unusual movement called the Second Tourmaline Rush, she and her colleague Shizuma were sent to Harmonie.
[spoiler]Her real name is Emilia Crocco.[/spoiler]

[Translated from [url=http://cabbage-soft.com/character/]Official Website[/url]]
